posts.headline: One Nut Barner has now gone an entire month without a word, and Put it in Ra's ridiculous 20-8 career mark with a 1.5 average finish and ZERO rings remains the most disrespected résumé this league has ever produced.
posts.detail: Two seasons, back-to-back top-two finishes, a .714 win percentage — and somehow this is the quietest team in Busters Anonymous. Silence isn't humility at this point, it's a crime scene.

posts.headline: Draft is over, rosters are set, and Big Head STILL hasn't explained how a title banner hangs over a losing 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: Sasinci's World carries a ring and a 5.5 average finish in the same breath — that's not a résumé, that's a contradiction with a haircut. Talk is cheap, Megamind; the scoreboard's about to start.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh just finished the draft still owning the single worst résumé in the league, and nothing in that war room suggests the untalented tenth found a scouting department.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish got this team its nickname fair and square — now we get to see if the 2026 roster reads any better than the 2025 tragedy.

posts.headline: Thicks and the #FreeMaxx Champions finished their draft, and now the excuses run out — a 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish says the ring has been doing all the talking for two straight seasons.
posts.detail: Defending a title is easy on paper when your actual body of work is a coin flip. Time to see if this new roster finally matches the hype the ring keeps writing checks for.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh just wrapped a draft nobody's talking about, and the worst win percentage in the league doesn't get fixed by a fresh set of names on a roster card.
posts.detail: A 5-9 record and a dead-last 11th-place finish is the résumé here — the Prince of Persia needs an actual coronation on the field before anyone starts believing in a turnaround.
